title: feat(mlk14): mid-leave same-k fails at k=14: t=26 vs t=46
science: FORCING NEGATIVE / self-refuting member. The 'mid-leave' clause (1->2 with max|w|=1 and max|v|>=2) is PROVABLY EMPTY on the six-neighbour graph: a support-2 destination with max 1 is a signed permutation of (1,1,0), whose support-1 nearest neighbours are signed axis units with max 1, so the source threshold can never be met. The runner counts extra_nn = 0. mu-lambda is therefore identically rho3 a
